objective: Decide whether zero-shot cross-dataset missing-measurement transfer is supportable, must be narrowed to fixed-budget calibration, or must be stopped.

prohibited: change or widen the V5 guard
describe V5 as a near pass
use any future validation holdout during V6 development

operating_modes.zero_shot: No labels, target-derived normalization, or calibration rows from the held-out dataset.

calibration_budget_candidates: one early checkup per calibration cell
few_shot.evaluation_rule: Calibration cells may not also be evaluation cells. Choose one budget using development folds only.

preregistered_representations.contents: V5 normalized baseline spectrum plus SOC and relative pulse resistance
separate absolute impedance scale, normalized spectral shape, and relative spectral change
preregistered_representations.purpose: test whether cell scale is confounded with shape

preregistered_representations.contents: frequency-wise current-to-baseline ratios or scale-normalized deltas with SOC, temperature, and relative pulse resistance
predeclared low, mid, and high band summaries plus shared grid points
stable ECM or DRT summaries only if one extractor passes identical synthetic and repeatability checks for every included dataset
preregistered_representations.fallback: exclude this representation before scoring if extraction comparability fails

preregistered_representations.contents: SOC, temperature, relative pulse resistance, impedance scale, and a small fixed spectral-shape summary

conditional: leave-one-chemistry-out if at least two chemistries have complete compatible rows
temperature or protocol holdout if identifiers are explicit
forbidden: random row split as primary evidence
same cell in train and test
same checkup in train and test

metrics.eis: RMSE by component and frequency, plus relative improvement versus the best eligible baseline
metrics.soh: MAE in percentage points and relative improvement versus the best eligible baseline
metrics.uncertainty: 90 percent interval empirical coverage on accepted rows, reported by held-out dataset

hard_decision.condition: Zero-shot fails and every few-shot gate passes.
Neither preceding condition passes. Do not start V7 automatically.

claim_boundary: This is a development contract, not evidence that V6 works. Spent datasets may select V6; only a later genuinely untouched one-shot run can validate a frozen candidate.
